claim: Kasteelhotel d'Aertrycke in Torhout sits in the grounds of a historic castle on 104 acres of countryside and offers 20 guest rooms in the former coach house, with breakfast included.
quote: The Hotel D'Aertrycke is located in the grounds of the historical Kasteel d'Aertrycke, situated in 104 acres of beautiful countryside and surrounded by gardens, woods and lakes. The hotel is located behind the beautiful and historic facade of the castle's former coach house and features 20 guest rooms.

claim: Hotels in Torhout (incl. Kasteel d'Aertrycke area) start from around $165 per night in 2026.
quote: THE 5 BEST Hotels in Torhout, Belgium 2026 (from $165)

claim: Hotel Damier on Kortrijk's Grote Markt is the oldest hotel in Belgium, dating to 1398, with a Rococo facade from 1769, 65 rooms and a luxury apartment with kitchenette and terrace.
quote: Hotel Damier is a charming four-star hotel located on the Grote Markt in Kortrijk and is the oldest hotel in Belgium, dating back to 1398... 65 beautifully appointed rooms and one luxury apartment with kitchenette and terrace.

claim: Hotel Damier is bookable as a WorldHotels Crafted property via Best Western channels in addition to direct booking.
quote: Hotel Damier - WorldHotels Crafted in Kortijk Belgium

claim: Relais Bourgondisch Cruyce in Bruges is a 16-room luxury boutique hotel at the meeting point of two historic canals, housed in one of the city's oldest half-timbered gabled buildings with curated antiques and works inspired by Botero, Chagall, Klimt and Matisse.
quote: With just 16 individually designed rooms, timeless interiors, and exceptional comfort, every stay is shaped by heritage, romance, and quiet elegance... a carefully curated collection of antiques and artworks inspired by masters such as Botero, Chagall, Klimt, and Matisse.

claim: Relais & Châteaux Hotel Heritage is the only Relais & Châteaux member in Bruges, with 22 rooms in Louis XVI style, a fine-dining restaurant Le Mystique and a Sothys boutique spa.
quote: The Heritage has 22 rooms blending comfort and classic elegance... The hotel features a fine dining restaurant 'Le Mystique' and a boutique spa 'Le Moment by Sothys'.

claim: Rooms at Hotel Heritage Bruges range from about $260 up to $782, averaging around $380 per night.
quote: Rooms at Relais & Chateaux Hotel Heritage range from $260 to $782, with average pricing around $380 per night.

claim: Hotel Dukes' Palace Bruges is a five-star superior set in the former residence of the Burgundian aristocracy with 135 rooms including 22 suites, a 3,000 m² garden, restaurant and spa.
quote: The hotel has 135 rooms, 22 of which are suites, combining modern comfort with authentic elegance from the 15th century... 3,000 m² garden, restaurant, terrace, and bar, as well as 'The Spa' with sauna, Turkish bath, and fitness area.

claim: Hotel De Tuilerieën is a 15th-century mansion on the Dijver canal in Bruges and became the third five-star hotel in Bruges (only the 8th in Flanders) in April 2025.
quote: De Tuilerieen is set in a stately 15th-century mansion on the picturesque canal, Den Dijver... only the 8th in Flanders when it was awarded its fifth star in April 2025.

claim: Slow Cabins are 30–40 m² off-grid eco-cabins in secret Belgian locations, self-sufficient on solar and rainwater, with the exact spot revealed 14 days before arrival; six regions are bookable.
quote: Slow Cabins are ecological cabins (30-40 m²) that are completely self-sufficient in terms of water and electricity. Each tiny cabin is self-sufficient and includes solar panel roofs, filtered rainwater collection, and a dry toilet.

claim: Slow Cabins are priced at €175–€275 per night with a two-night minimum and locations chosen to be under two hours from major Belgian cities.
quote: Prices range between 175 and 275 euros per night for a two-night stay... locations always less than 2 hours from a major Belgian city.

claim: Treelodge offers luxurious treehouse accommodations in the Roeselare area of West Flanders for a tranquil glamping stay.
quote: Treelodge... offers a unique glamping experience in Roesolare, West Flanders, Belgium, with luxurious treehouse accommodations nestled in a serene natural setting.

claim: Hotel Messeyne is a 28-room boutique hotel in central Kortrijk just 5 minutes from the Grote Markt with French-cuisine restaurant, courtyard terrace, gym, sauna and steam bath.
quote: Hotel Messeyne is a boutique hotel situated in the center of Kortrijk... The hotel has 28 air-conditioned rooms... The restaurant at Messeyne Hotel serves traditional and modern French cuisine in an elegant setting, with a courtyard terrace.

claim: Kortrijk taxis start at €2.40 and charge €2.80 per km in 2026, while most other West Flanders cities (Ypres, Poperinge, Blankenberge, De Panne) start at €4.90 with €1.90 per km.
